map.赔付率 = 赔款支出 ÷ 保费收入。: Loss ratio = claim payments ÷ premium income.

map.赔付率越低盈利空间越大。: The lower the loss ratio, the larger the profit margin.
map.综合成本率还需计入费用率。: The combined ratio must also include the expense ratio.
map.📚 深度解析：赔付率（已决赔款/保费）: 📚 Deep Dive: Loss Ratio (Paid Claims / Premium)
map.看保费里多少赔出去了，是承保质量核心。: See how much of premium is paid out as claims - the core of underwriting quality.
map.赔付率 = 650/1000 = 65%。即每 1 元保费赔出 0.65 元。: Loss ratio = 650/1000 = 65%. That is, 0.65 of every premium yuan is paid out.
map.已决和已发生赔付率差？: Difference between paid and incurred loss ratios?
map.已决只看已结；已发生含 IBNR 更全。发展早期已决偏低、随理赔成熟上升。: Paid looks only at settled claims; incurred includes IBNR and is more complete. Early in development paid is low and rises as claims mature.
map.赔付率 70% 算好还是坏？: Is a 70% loss ratio good or bad?
map.单看赔付率不够。70% 赔付率加25% 费用率等于95% 综合成本率（承保微利）: A loss ratio alone is not enough. 70% loss ratio + 25% expense ratio = 95% combined ratio (thin underwriting profit); but with a high expense ratio, 70% can still break even negative. Always read the combined ratio with the expense ratio.
